thread:
maya: Quick thread 4545 - I'm updating the Dedicated Capacity runbook to clarify autoscale examples, SLA language, and isolation behaviors. Opening a PR shortly. Need quick UX + eng reviews.

liam: Please include a compact YAML snippet that people can copy for label-based routing + scale policy.

maya: Adding this example to the runbook:
```yaml
tenant_id: acme-42
labels:
  - priority:high
  - sector:finance
scale_policy:
  minReplicas: 2
  maxReplicas: 20
  cooldown: 180
isolation:
  mode: committed
  preemption: false
```

sam: Small nit: our SDK examples use camelCase like `minReplicas`/`maxReplicas` - keep that in the SDK mapping appendix. Also add a one-liner SDK snippet.

priscilla: I'll add a short JS snippet under docs/examples/dedicated/sdk-quickstart.md and link it from the runbook. Example: `await client.dedicated.create({ tenantId: 'acme-42', labels: ['priority:high'], scalePolicy: { minReplicas:2, maxReplicas:20 } })`.

yuki: For SLA wording, suggest an "illustrative" table (non-contractual) comparing Committed vs Best-effort. Also include a callout that "Committed" implies reserved pool backing and no preemption; "Best-effort" may be preempted under pressure.

maya: Draft SLA text added to PR. Also added a short rollback checklist (Dedicated -> Shared) covering token rotation, traffic cutover, and monitoring checks.

liam: Found one link pointing to /old/cli/provision - updated to /docs/cli/dedicated.md.

priscilla: Pushed the JS snippet and a tiny Terraform example in a follow-up commit.

docs-bot: PR opened by maya: PR #901 - "Dedicated runbook: autoscale examples & SLA clarifications". Requested reviewers: liam, priscilla. Preview build queued: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-901

sam: LGTM pending docs CI. If anyone sees phrasing that could be misread as a promise about latency, please flag before merge.

maya: Thanks all 4545 - will merge after 2 approvals + green CI.
